usage:
Usage:
  {command} export --hub <URL> --token-file <file> --output <new file> [--include-steps] <computer-id> <session-id>

Exports this conversation as Markdown. The token must belong to a paired device.
invalid_id: Provide a valid computer and session ID.
invalid_hub: Set --hub to an HTTPS URL or local HTTP URL without credentials, a query, or a fragment.
token: Couldn't read a paired-device token from --token-file.
retrying: The conversation changed. Reading it again…
hub_version: This hub can't identify one conversation for export. Update the hub and try again.
http_error: The hub answered HTTP {status} while reading the conversation.
changed: The conversation changed during export. Run the command again when it settles.
limit: The conversation exceeded an export limit. No Markdown file was written.
missing: The hub didn't list this conversation. Check the computer ID and the current session ID.
read_failed: Couldn't reach the hub to read the conversation.
incomplete: Couldn't read the complete conversation. No Markdown file was written.
exists: The output path already exists. Choose a new file.
timed_out: Timed out while exporting the conversation.
output_failed: Couldn't write the Markdown file. Check the destination folder and its permissions.
title: Conversation
node_version: The hub or the conversation's runtime cannot confirm a fresh transcript read. Update the hub and node, or use a runtime with a readable local transcript.
clipped: More of this work step is available in the conversation.
